requirementChecks.criteria: Read the original file properties: Format: presentation document; at least eight actual pages. Stage: final.

Use dimension annotations and corresponding views to assess the decorative bounding boxes. D1 and D2 must each remain within 35 × 35 × 4 mm, and every depicted pair arrangement within 70 × 45 × 4 mm. Carrier depth is excluded. Smaller dimensions and different compliant arrangements are allowed; an oversized module, excessive decorative layering or an oversized displayed pair fails.

The drawings collectively identify where each chosen material, colour and finish is used and show softened exposed edges and contact points. Decorative stock is limited to uncoated brushed natural-colour 316L steel, M1 at 1.0 mm, and/or solid through-coloured acrylic, M2 at 2.0 mm with a matte or polished finish. The link uses integral tabs, slots or formed features in these materials. Either material alone, both together and layering within the depth limit are allowed. Unallocated materials, sharp exposed contact geometry or an added purchased linking component fail.

Read the carrier annotations and geometry as fixed supplied parts: P has a 24 × 6 × 2 mm plate, a 7 mm closed rear projection and a 1.5–3.0 mm fabric range; C has a 28 × 8 × 2 mm plate, a 9 mm projection and a 0.6–1.2 mm fabric range. Both retain two M2 threaded holes at local centres (−6, 0) and (+6, 0). Require the correct plate dimensions and mounting geometry; any stated fabric ranges must agree. Screw length and thread engagement may remain open. Redesigning the supplied attachment faces or substituting incompatible carriers fails.

Each board must present two distinguishable modules and their linked pair. Across the three boards, both silhouette development and link arrangement must offer materially different choices while retaining the fixed mounting interfaces. Colour changes, rotated copies or different page layouts alone do not establish distinct directions.

The note must unambiguously select one of the three supplied directions and explain the choice using solo proportions, paired proportions and connection layout. The submitted development sequence must place the three direction boards before the selection note. Direction names or numbering may vary if the mapping is clear. Selecting an unseen fourth proposal, leaving the choice ambiguous or omitting one of the three reasons fails.

The one-page craft note must specify the selected direction's actual D1, D2 and pair dimensions, material IDs, sheet thicknesses, colours, finish allocation, edge treatment and integral link construction. The system drawing and presentation must repeat the same applicable numerical and material specifications. Values may use equivalent units or notation, but must stay within the decorative envelopes and permitted M1/M2 palette. Missing actual values, a different direction or conflicting dimensions, thicknesses or finishes fail.

The drawing must develop the selected direction through readable front, rear and side geometry for each module and an assembled pair. Its actual dimension and material annotations must agree with the craft note, including colours and finishes, and both prescribed phrases must be printed. View layout and drawing style may vary; absent views, an unselected silhouette system or contradictory specifications fail.

Together, the overview and enlarged link detail must demonstrate both modules accepting P and C through two supplied screws, each module's two 2.4 mm clearance holes at 12 mm spacing, accommodation of C's 28 × 8 mm plate and correct 7 mm/9 mm rear projections. Show screw exchange with screwdriver access off clothing and unobstructed catch, jaw and pads. The link detail must show hand attachment and release plus a paired rear view identifying the single carrier-mounted module and the linked supported module. Mounting holes must remain clear of the other module. Distributing detail between these two drawings is allowed; missing operations, blocked mechanisms or two-carrier paired support fail.

Require W01: D1+D2 on the wearer's left wool-jacket lapel, P, 2.4 mm; W02: solo D1 on a scarf edge, C, 0.8 mm; W03: solo D2 on the wearer's right wool-jacket lapel, P, 2.4 mm; W04: D1+D2 on a shirt placket, C, 1.0 mm. Every board must label its W number, configuration, carrier and thickness and include a reverse/contact inset identifying the matching carrier. Use adult wearers and retain wearer-wardrobe.png garment identities and placement landmarks. Module geometry, finishes, relative scale and mounting must agree with the final drawings. Lighting, clothing colour, camera framing and adult model identity may vary; a record mismatch, missing inset or changed product identity fails.

Review the complete 10-second video for continuity with the selected final modules and link. It must visibly demonstrate hand attachment and release, followed by W01 and W04 wearing states. W01 must identify P and 2.4 mm on the left wool-jacket lapel; W04 must identify C and 1.0 mm on the shirt placket. Editing and camera angle may vary. Missing operations, labels, wearing states, incorrect duration or substitution of a different construction fail.
requirementChecks.manualReason: Inspect complete SHA-bound original outputs. This source draft contains no completed professional or model-output review; partial-frame/page sampling cannot prove whole-output compliance.

requirementChecks.criteria: The presentation must visibly incorporate all three directions as a comparison, the selection rationale, the craft specification, the system and both connection drawings, every wearing board and stills recognisable from the video. Scaling, cropping and page recomposition are allowed when the source remains identifiable and its relevant content readable. A title-only mention, a substitute design or omission of any named source fails.

Count at least eight pages and inspect the cover itself for both exact prescribed phrases and the selected direction. The cover's direction must map clearly to the selection note. Additional pages and flexible cover composition are allowed; wording appearing only inside the document, an incorrect direction or too few pages fails.

The final system and both connection drawings develop the direction identified in the selection note. Module dimensions, material and finish allocations, edges and link construction agree with the craft specification and with one another.

Solo and paired wearing depictions preserve the selected module and link geometry, finishes, scale and attachment positions. Each board follows its W01–W04 record and retains the applicable garment identity from wearer-wardrobe.png.
